title: Banned

replies.author: AstroPizza
replies.body:
Hey Pabl0wl
You have to understand what you do on your account is your responsibility.
Even if we/you had proof of it being an accident you would still remain banned.
Also , remember from our point of view this seems very unreasonable with a client like killaura which is very obvious to tell if you're using even to yourself ; Surprised you didn't realise quick enough to turn t off if this is the case.

I'll repeat what i said at the start ; Your account is your responsibility what happens on it is your own fault and therefore must suffer the same punishment like everyone else.

I'm sorry but you can appeal again in roughly 6 months.
Appeal Denied

Will lock in 24 hours or once requested
